answer: Copying the same citations across 136 aliases therefore forfeits the authoring cost 136 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the crystal index resolves every citation against the trellis checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the whisper audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 3403 identities would post 3507 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
